motor.name: salient_ipmsm
motor.comment: Interior PMSM with real saliency (Lq = 3x Ld): the plant torque includes the (Ld-Lq)*id*iq reluctance term. Exercised by any FOC graph that holds id != 0 (e.g. MTPA reference generators, see Assets/Examples/foc_mtpa_demo.json and Images/HostSIL/scenarios/sil_foc_salient.json).
